headline: Nigeria Arrests 14 Chinese Nationals Over Illegal Lithium Processing Plants
summary: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission arrested 14 Chinese nationals and one Nigerian over four illegal lithium processing plants.
why: Lithium is a critical mineral used in rechargeable batteries for electric vehicles and electronics. Crackdowns on illicit extraction impact mineral supply governance and regulatory compliance for mining operators.

impacts.name: Mining
impacts.why: Stricter enforcement against illegal mining operations affects local mineral processing supply chains.
